name: fitness-frontend
description: Fork von fitness-dev src/ + catalog-ui/ gegen das neue Python-Backend (backend/, :9150). Firebase-Build bleibt erhalten.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:catalog
scripts.build:training: pnpm run build:kb-data && vite build --mode training --outDir dist-training && node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs sw dist-training --app frontend && node scripts/stamp-training.mjs dist-training && node scripts/snapshot.mjs dist-training
scripts.build:atlas: pnpm run build:kb-data && vite build --mode atlas --outDir dist-atlas && node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs sw dist-atlas --app frontend && node scripts/stamp-training.mjs dist-atlas "VitalOS Atlas" Atlas "/#atlas" "Übungsdatenbank durchsuchen — Atlas als eigene App" && node scripts/snapshot.mjs dist-atlas
scripts.build:firebase: vite build --mode firebase --outDir dist-firebase && node scripts/stamp-sw.mjs dist-firebase
scripts.build:kb-data: node scripts/build-sixpack-data.mjs && node scripts/exercise-data.mjs && node scripts/build-coaching-notes.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:queue && pnpm run test:smoke
